pages: The network knew my shape the moment I touched it. It has been waiting for something like me.
It remembers every death that fed it. It plays them back in pulses of blue light, and every pulse has a face.
I know these faces. I signed their
. I sent them down to the deepest nodes to take readings.
They are still down there. They are the readings now.
The Sculk is not a parasite. It is a library.

pages.text: And I am the one who filled the shelves.
